bullets: Set technical direction across 4 squads (11 backend engineers) in payment, ecosystem, growth, and consumer, owning architecture decisions and partnering with product on feature scope.

Architected and built a high-throughput CDC pipeline streaming MongoDB data into ClickHouse using Debezium, Google Pub/Sub, and Go, processing 540k+ events/minute to power all user-facing real-time analytics across the company.
Owned the technical side of Bosta's ISO 27001 audit, from validating pentest findings to remediation, unlocking a partnership with the Egyptian Ministry of Transport.
Co-designed the backend interview process for junior and senior engineers and conducted technical interviews, establishing a consistent technical hiring standard.
Implemented distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry and ClickHouse (via ClickStack), improving observability and reducing time to diagnose production issues.
Migrated logging infrastructure from GCP Cloud Logging to Elasticsearch using FluentBit, enhancing observability, reducing logging costs, and improving log search performance.
Led a team of 3 engineers in the platform squad, focused on improving performance, scalability, and security.
Led security for the platform, identifying and remediating vulnerabilities and driving incident response.
Built an automated fraud detection system using Stream Processing and Apache Flink.

Architected and built a real-time shipment SLA “Control Tower” to monitor compliance across every delivery phase using event-driven architecture and GCP Cloud Tasks, reducing SLA breaches through proactive delay detection and alerting.

Led development of sub-regional (L2) hub assignment, achieving 92% accuracy and 94% coverage by determining the correct zone within multi-zone hubs, improving last-mile precision and operational efficiency.

Improved automated delivery hub assignment to 98.5% accuracy and 99.8% coverage by replacing Google Maps with a custom in-house solution, saving tens of thousands of dollars and powering the largest automated sorting facility in the middle east.
Built Bosta Maps, an internal geocoding service using OpenStreetMap and PostGIS with custom search algorithms to reduce Google Maps API usage in supporting workflows, cutting external API costs.
Built an event-driven reward system consuming signup events via Kafka to issue discounts across the website and store builders.
Built and deployed the company's first API documentation, enabling external companies to integrate with the platform.
Reduced API latency by 50% by caching CORS preflight responses.
